title: Report layer = §6.3 doc + det-only audit pipeline + 3 renderers, deterministic w/ injectable clock
rationale: trellis-59ea builds src/report/ as the per-run §6.3 surface: build.ts auditRepo is the surface-agnostic core pipeline (rubric→discovery→registry→detectors per app/repo→scoring→Report) that CLI+SDK fold; agent criteria short-circuit to no-detector('investigation layer not yet wired') BEFORE the registry (registry stays deterministic-only), repo-scope runs once at root w/ unioned languages, app-scope runs per app then aggregateAppScope. Renderers: json.ts (JSON.stringify insertion-order = determinism anchor), markdown.ts (PR scorecard), terminal.ts (human), sharing rollup.ts rollupByCategory/tally (renderers take the Rubric for category membership since Report.criteria carries none). Determinism: pipeline pure given (checkout,rubric,detectors); scoredAt is the ONLY wall-clock field, injectable via opts.now — two runs serialize byte-identically sans timestamp. CLI passes preloaded rubric into auditRepo+renderers to avoid double-load. Goldens under __golden__/ w/ TRELLIS_UPDATE_REPORT_GOLDEN gate.
